title: Propose scaled warm starts with K1 K2 and K4
doing: After S0/S1 and S2 speed/memory gates, propose a fresh-stream scaled warm-start matrix from420 at K1/K2/K4 with matched raw frames, gamma/GAE and rollout game-time coverage. Separate the K4 seed-pool contrast from the joint scaling comparison; retain lower-tail primary metrics and training replicas. This is a conditional design, not launch-ready registration.
expected: Fresh seeds may improve generalization after the confirmed512-pool reuse. K1/K2 may learn differently with qualified larger batches and longer per-env histories, but the earlier K1 regression may persist. Equal frames will not imply equal decisions, FLOPs or wall time.
next_step: Complete approved S1 and S2 speed/memory work, then freeze actual budgets and arm registrations with Taylor. Do not launch the conditional proposal.
